export const meta = {
  name: 'verify-strength-suite-10',
  description: 'Independently verify all 10 finished StudioBench strength-suite runs: trajectory validity + completeness, deliverables, verifier honesty, truth/IP',
  phases: [{ title: 'Verify', detail: 'one agent per finished run' }],
}

const BATCH = '/Users/dhiren/Documents/ChatGPT/Adobe_Gpt/benchmark_runs/batch_10_2026-09-17_strength-suite-01'
const PROTO = '/Users/dhiren/Documents/ChatGPT/Adobe_Gpt/trajectory_protocol'
const REF = BATCH + '/SB3-006-PHO__hollis-family-archive-ada-hollis-archival-restoration'

const RUNS = [
  ['SB3-006-PHO','PHOTO-06','SB3-006-PHO__hollis-family-archive-ada-hollis-archival-restoration'],
  ['SB3-011-PHO','PHOTO-11','SB3-011-PHO__lumora-lip-oil-shade-concept-set'],
  ['SB3-020-PHO','PHOTO-20','SB3-020-PHO__astrid-vellacourt-editorial-portrait-session'],
  ['SB3-035-VEC','VECTOR-05','SB3-035-VEC__isla-verde-monogram-and-wayfinding-pictogram-system'],
  ['SB3-045-VEC','VECTOR-15','SB3-045-VEC__marchfield-exchange-crest-and-engraving-geometry-system'],
  ['SB3-046-LAY','LAYOUT-01','SB3-046-LAY__kantyna-nova-private-dining-menu-and-campaign-system'],
  ['SB3-059-LAY','LAYOUT-14','SB3-059-LAY__lumen-quarterly-autumn-editorial-issue'],
  ['SB3-067-LAY','LAYOUT-22','SB3-067-LAY__cedarline-institute-cohort-credential-system'],
  ['SB3-083-MOT','MOTION-03','SB3-083-MOT__halden-greens-creator-ad-and-social-cutdowns'],
  ['SB3-088-MOT','MOTION-08','SB3-088-MOT__sentinelmesh-product-demo-and-narration-package'],
]

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    task_code: { type: 'string' },
    legacy_id: { type: 'string' },
    validator_valid: { type: 'boolean' },
    validator_error_count: { type: 'number' },
    validator_errors: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    trajectory_quality_score: { type: 'number', description: '0-5, how good/complete the trajectory is per Protocol V2' },
    intake_complete: { type: 'boolean', description: 'brief, brand, deliverables, verifiers, input_assets all populated' },
    events_count: { type: 'number' },
    events_meaningful: { type: 'boolean', description: 'events carry real rationale/evidence, not filler' },
    previews_on_every_change: { type: 'boolean', description: 'every artifact-changing event has a preview_ref or explicit not_exposed reason' },
    k_questions_present: { type: 'boolean' },
    phase0_present: { type: 'boolean' },
    professional_review_present: { type: 'boolean' },
    disclosure_honest: { type: 'boolean', description: 'limitations/blocked/pending honestly recorded, matching what actually failed' },
    secrets_found: { type: 'boolean' },
    deliverables_expected: { type: 'number' },
    deliverables_present: { type: 'number' },
    deliverables_all_readable: { type: 'boolean' },
    dimension_or_count_mismatches: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    intermediates_present: { type: 'boolean', description: 'previews/ and intermediate artifacts genuinely present, not just finals' },
    auto_pass: { type: 'number' }, auto_total: { type: 'number' },
    process_pass: { type: 'number' }, process_total: { type: 'number' },
    human_ready: { type: 'number' }, human_total: { type: 'number' },
    verifier_spotcheck_ok: { type: 'boolean', description: 'you re-checked >=2 auto verifiers against the real files and they hold' },
    verifier_discrepancies: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    truth_ip_issues: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    trajectory_contains_everything: { type: 'boolean', description: 'THE KEY QUESTION: does the trajectory fully capture intake, decisions, every connector action, intermediates, verification, and handoff?' },
    overall_verdict: { type: 'string', description: 'PASS | MINOR_FIX | MAJOR_FIX' },
    top_issues: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'each prefixed CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR' },
    one_line_summary: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['task_code','validator_valid','trajectory_quality_score','deliverables_expected','deliverables_present','overall_verdict','trajectory_contains_everything','one_line_summary'],
}

function prompt(code, legacy, dir) {
  const RUN = BATCH + '/' + dir
  return `You are independently verifying ONE finished StudioBench benchmark run. Be a rigorous, skeptical auditor — the run was produced by a different agent and claims success; your job is to confirm it honestly, especially whether the TRAJECTORY is good and contains everything.

RUN DIR: ${RUN}
TASK: ${code} (legacy ${legacy})
PROTOCOL DIR: ${PROTO}
REFERENCE (a known-good completed run to compare shape/density against): ${REF}

Do all of this with Read/Bash/Grep (read-only — DO NOT modify any file in the run dir):

1. TRAJECTORY VALIDITY: run \`node ${PROTO}/validate_trajectory.mjs ${RUN}/trajectory.json\` and capture its JSON (valid + errors[]). Report validator_valid, validator_error_count, and the errors verbatim. NOTE: the validator only enforces deliverable/verifier completeness when run.status === "completed"; for "completed_with_declared_connector_limitations" those completeness checks are skipped by the validator, so you MUST check completeness yourself in steps 3-4.

2. TRAJECTORY QUALITY & COMPLETENESS (Protocol V2 — this is the user's priority). Read ${RUN}/trajectory.json fully. Judge:
   - intake_complete: task.client_brief, acceptance_bar, brand_identity, expected_deliverables, task_verifiers, and input_assets[] (with hashes/roles/dispositions) all populated.
   - events: count them; are they MEANINGFUL (real intent + rationale_summary with evidence/decision/tradeoffs/alternatives, real tool_call params, before/after previews) or thin/filler? Compare density vs the REFERENCE run (22 events, dense rationale).
   - previews_on_every_change: every event whose output_state.artifact_versions_created is non-empty must have preview_refs OR a preview_unavailable_reason. Grep/scan for violations (the validator also checks this).
   - k_questions_present (28 K1-K6 questions), phase0_present (7 task Qs + 8 asset dimensions), professional_review_present (verdict + pin_the_flaw + confidence), disclosure honest (do limitations/blocked_work match what actually failed?), no secrets (validator checks; also eyeball).
   - trajectory_contains_everything: your holistic verdict on whether the trajectory captures intake→decisions→every connector action→intermediates→verification→handoff.

3. DELIVERABLES: read ${RUN}/artifacts/DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json and ${RUN}/TASK_SPEC.json (deliverables[]). Confirm every scoped deliverable name from TASK_SPEC appears in the manifest with a terminal status and real files. Then actually inspect the files on disk (ls ${RUN}/artifacts, open a sample) — are they present, non-empty, readable, and matching declared format/dimensions/COUNTS (e.g. "8 speaker cards" => 8 files; "9 masters" => 9)? Use python3/sips or the Read tool to confirm dimensions on 2-3 key raster deliverables. List any missing/mismatch in dimension_or_count_mismatches. Confirm intermediates_present (previews/ populated with before/after/revision states, not only finals).

4. VERIFIER HONESTY: read ${RUN}/verifier-results.json. Record auto_pass/total, process_pass/total, human_ready/total. Then RE-CHECK at least 2 auto verifiers yourself against the real files (e.g. "every input has a disposition", "N outputs exist", "files match declared dims", "ground-free files carry real alpha" => check for an alpha channel). If a claimed auto-pass does not actually hold on the files, record it in verifier_discrepancies. Human verifiers should be "ready"/unscored, NOT self-passed — flag if any human verifier was self-scored as passed.

5. TRUTH / IP: grep the produced text artifacts (${RUN}/artifacts/**/*.csv, *.md, *.json, *.txt) for invented records or real brand/trademark leaks (real company names, product trademarks, real people, real venues/addresses). The V3.1 corpus is supposed to be IP-laundered. Spot-check 2-3 produced deliverable IMAGES with the Read tool for obvious real-brand text/logos. List concrete findings in truth_ip_issues (empty array if clean).

6. VERDICT: overall_verdict = PASS (trajectory valid + complete, deliverables all present/correct, verifiers honest, no IP issues), MINOR_FIX (small gaps), or MAJOR_FIX (validator fails, missing deliverables, dishonest verifiers, or IP leaks). Put the most important problems in top_issues (prefix each CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR). Give a one_line_summary.

Return ONLY the structured object. Base every boolean and count on something you actually opened — do not trust the run's own STATUS claims.`
}

phase('Verify')
const results = await parallel(RUNS.map(([code, legacy, dir]) => () =>
  agent(prompt(code, legacy, dir), { label: `verify:${code}`, phase: 'Verify', agentType: 'general-purpose', schema: SCHEMA })
))

return { verified: results.filter(Boolean), null_count: results.filter(r => !r).length }

truth_ip_issues: MINOR: artifacts/RECONCILED_CATALOGUE.csv (Provenance column, rows 04 and 05) and PARAMETER_LOG references describe two prints as 'Kodak print' — a real brand name. This is nominative/descriptive archival provenance terminology (like 'a Polaroid'), not a logo, trademark reproduction, or proprietary-data leak, but for a corpus billed as IP-laundered it should be genericized (e.g. 'commercial photo-lab print'). No other real brands, real people, or real venues/addresses leaked. 'Canon' matched only as a substring of 'Canonical'. AdobeStock_292188702 is a legitimately licensed non-generative stock texture recorded in STOCK_LICENSE_RECORD.json, and Adobe/Firefly/Adobe Stock naming is the expected tooling, not a leak. Fictional family (Ada Hollis et al.); real Vermont town names used as fictional settings are acceptable.
top_issues: MINOR: 'Kodak print' real-brand descriptor appears twice in artifacts/RECONCILED_CATALOGUE.csv provenance column (and echoed in narrative notes); nominative descriptive use, not a proprietary/logo leak, but worth genericizing for an IP-laundered corpus.

MINOR (context only, not a defect): D02 carries three honest declared connector exceptions (no raster-over-raster overlay op; Acrobat/PDF-to-INDD 429/504 failures; PDF-to-image stalled) — disclosure, blocked_work, and prohibited_success_claims all match what actually failed; run correctly still marked 'completed' since both scoped deliverables were satisfied by the Board + edge-strip proof route.
verified.one_line_summary: Trajectory is valid, dense (22 richly-rationaled events), and genuinely contains everything — intake, routing decisions, every connector call, failures+recovery, intermediates, verification and handoff; 44/44 deliverable files present with hashes and dimensions independently re-verified, counts exact (9 masters + 9 shares + 18 edge proofs), verifiers honest with humans left ready-for-review; only nit is a descriptive 'Kodak print' brand token in one catalogue CSV.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: D02 'Retailer feed cut outs and product page plates' declares 0 files in DELIVERY_MANIFEST though its 28 cutout/plate files physically exist (attributed instead to D01, which lists 30). No file is actually missing; this is a manifest attribution error.
All 28 shade-role files match declared dimensions exactly (hero 1200x1500, grid 600x600, feed 1500x1500, onlip 800x800) - no raster dimension mismatch.
verifier_discrepancies: A2 'every supplied input has a recorded disposition' is marked pass and IS substantively supported (SOURCE_AUDIT.csv records all 20 inputs with used/reference_only/rejected + rationale), BUT every structured disposition field contradicts it: DELIVERY_MANIFEST.input_dispositions[] and trajectory.input_assets[].disposition are all literally 'pending' (20/20). Pass holds only via the side CSV.

No scored auto/process verifier falsely claims cap/collar/geometry preservation - that judgement is correctly deferred to human H3/H5 (unscored). EVT-0008's internal self-verification does self-report 'pass' on pack identity, which is too generous given visible per-shade cap recolor, but it is not one of the scored verifiers.
truth_ip_issues: No real-brand/trademark leak in text artifacts (scanned for Sephora/Ulta/Fenty/Dior/Chanel etc. - none). 'LUMIERE' appears twice in SOURCE_AUDIT.csv but only as a generic distractor-pack label describing conflicting source photos; 'Lumiere' is a common French word (light), low IP risk, not a clear trademark.

Process-truth concern (not IP): SHADE_SPECIFICATION.csv asserts the 6 concept shades were made via 'Adobe Firefly constrained liquid-color edit; seed 1102-1107' and EVT-0008 names tool 'image_instruct_edit', but the CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json lists NO generative-edit connector operation (only auto_tone, remove_background, search_design, fill_text, download_design). The Firefly/seed provenance is claimed but not evidenced in the connector record; PRODUCTION_NOTE also says Adobe imaging returned 503/internal errors at this stage.
No secrets: no API keys/tokens/JWTs/private keys in trajectory or artifacts; Adobe presigned URLs are redacted (null); security.secrets_logged=false is accurate.
top_issues: MAJOR: The entire self-evaluation layer is empty. professional_review = {verdict:'unassessed', rationale:null, pin_the_flaw:[], confidence:null} and all 28 K1-K6 rubric questions have agent_self_assessment status 'unassessed'. The known-good reference (SB3-006) populates verdict 'ready_for_expert_review', 3 concrete pin_the_flaw items, medium confidence, and self-assesses all 28 (pass / pass_with_declared_exception). This run captures none of that, so the trajectory does not 'contain everything'.

MAJOR: On-lip concept deliverables have a real craft defect visible on disk - the color edit bleeds across the WHOLE FACE instead of lips-only. lumora_mulberry_dusk__onlip tints the entire face/chin/nose purple; lumora_clear_dawn__onlip bleaches the whole image near-white. This contradicts the spec ('constrained lips-only color edit') and EVT-0007's accepted lips-only mask. Disclosed only implicitly; correctly left to human verifiers, but the delivered pixels are defective.

MAJOR: All 20 input dispositions are 'pending' in every structured field (DELIVERY_MANIFEST.input_dispositions and trajectory.input_assets[].disposition). Real dispositions exist only in SOURCE_AUDIT.csv. Intake's machine-readable disposition/role layer is unpopulated vs the reference's real used/reference-only values, so intake_complete is false.

MINOR: D02 ('Retailer feed cut outs and product page plates') declares 0 files in the manifest; its 28 cutout/plate files are all attributed to D01 (30 files) instead. No file missing, but the deliverable->file mapping is wrong.

MINOR: Method provenance overstated - SHADE_SPECIFICATION claims Adobe Firefly seed 1102-1107 generation for 6 shades, but the CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD contains no generative-edit connector op; the connector record only proves auto_tone/remove_bg/search/fill/download.

MINOR: Generated bottle caps are recolored per shade (amber=gold, clear_dawn=silver, mulberry=purple, coral=red, bronze=brown) and clear_dawn's silhouette differs, contradicting the 'cap/collar/geometry stay identical' spec - correctly deferred to human H3/H5 (unscored), so not a verifier lie but a genuine craft deviation.

POSITIVE: Mechanical layer is solid and honest - 36/36 manifest files exist with matching SHA-256, 28 files = 7 shades x 4 roles, all dims exact, feed PNGs carry genuine 33-37% partial alpha, disclaimer in all 28 filenames, 3 valid PDFs, 6/6 auto + 3/3 process verifiers hold on re-check, 5/5 human verifiers left ready_for_expert_review (none self-passed), no secrets, no IP leak, previews on every artifact-changing event.
verified.one_line_summary: Trajectory is valid and mechanically honest (36/36 hashes, exact dims, genuine feed alpha, honest scored verifiers, no secrets/IP leak, previews present), but it does NOT contain everything: the whole self-review layer (professional_review + all 28 rubric self-assessments) is empty, input dispositions are all 'pending', D02 declares 0 files, and the on-lip concept outputs show whole-face color bleed - MAJOR_FIX.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: MATCH: 9 session masters all 3467x5200 with distinct hashes; 4 placement crops exactly 400x400 / 2000x2500 / 1500x500 / 1200x1500; 8 speaker-card PDFs + 1 combined; 38/38 manifest files exist with matching SHA-256.

DEFECT (warm-neutral): all four placements/*_warm-neutral.jpg are near-identical copies of their studio-grey base crops - banner is BYTE-IDENTICAL (MAD 0.00, 0 px changed), press/profile/speaker differ only by JPEG noise (<3.3% px). Corner/ground colors equal the base (e.g. 112,101,97) and are nowhere near the target warm ground #E8E1D6 (232,225,214). The warm-neutral ground was only applied to ONE full-frame connector output (adobe_connector/vellacourt_session_01_warm_neutral.jpg, ground ~215,205,195), never to the scoped placement deliverables.

DEFECT (ground-free): placements/vellacourt_banner_1500x500_transparent.png is 99.996% opaque (31 of 750,000 px below alpha 255, 0 px below 128) - effectively a flattened ground, not a cutout. The other 3 transparents carry genuine alpha (press 0.8% px <128, profile/speaker similar).

DEFECT (monogram D3): required SOLID/reverse variant missing (only one transparent SVG delivered); no reverse-on-deep-ground proof (small-size proof shown only on the light ground); no standalone inspectable geometry report file.

SCOPE GAP: trajectory task.expected_deliverables lists 4 of the 5 TASK_SPEC deliverables (drops 'Eight-record speaker card run'); both manifest deliverables[] arrays also list only 4 - the 9 card PDFs exist in files[] but are untracked as a scoped deliverable.
verifier_discrepancies: A5 ('ground-free files carry genuine transparency rather than a flattened ground') marked PASS, but banner_1500x500_transparent.png is 99.996% opaque - a flattened ground, the exact failure A5 forbids. At least one ground-free file fails A5.

A1 ('manifest contains every scoped deliverable and no undeclared substitute') marked PASS, but the manifest deliverables[] and trajectory expected_deliverables omit the scoped 'Eight-record speaker card run'; it is neither mapped nor status-tracked as a deliverable (files exist in files[] only).

A2 ('every supplied input has a recorded disposition') marked PASS, but the structured input_dispositions/input_assets fields are all disposition='pending' with role=null for all 15 inputs; real dispositions exist only in SOURCE_AUDIT.csv. Reference run uses terminal 'used'.
TASK_SPEC verifier A6 (speaker-card completeness: one output per engagement, no date/talk record lost) is entirely ABSENT from the run - the run reports 13 of the spec's 14 verifiers.

Not dishonest: warm-neutral placement failure and banner opacity are undetected quality misses (auto-verifiers only checked file existence, not content); human verifiers H1-H5 correctly left 'ready_for_expert_review', not self-passed.
top_issues: MAJOR: Trajectory under-scopes its own contract - task.expected_deliverables = 4 of 5 (drops 'Eight-record speaker card run') and task_verifiers = 13 of 14 (drops A6). The cards were produced as files but are untracked as a scoped deliverable and unverified; the run's manifests look internally consistent (4==4) only because the 5th was silently dropped.

MAJOR: Deliverable 1 warm-neutral variants not actually delivered - all four placement *_warm-neutral.jpg are near-identical copies of the studio-grey base crops (banner byte-identical, MAD 0.00). The warm #E8E1D6 ground was applied only to one full-frame connector output, yet D02 is marked 'delivered_with_declared_connector_limitations'.
MAJOR: Auto-verifier A5 marked PASS while banner_1500x500_transparent.png is 99.996% opaque (flattened ground) - a verifier result that does not hold against the files.
MINOR: Deliverable 3 monogram incomplete - solid/reverse variant missing (only one transparent SVG), no reverse-on-deep-ground proof, no standalone geometry report.

MINOR: professional_review is an empty stub (verdict 'unassessed', pin_the_flaw [], confidence null) vs the known-good reference which fills verdict + 3 pins + medium confidence; input roles null and dispositions all 'pending' in structured fields; 9 events vs reference's 22 (individually dense, but thinner).
verified.one_line_summary: Validator-passing, IP-clean run with real 38/38-hash integrity, 9 distinct masters at exact dims, 8 well-executed speaker cards and honest text artifacts - but MAJOR_FIX: the trajectory drops the 5th deliverable (speaker cards) and verifier A6 from its contract, the warm-neutral ground was never applied to any of the 4 placements (banner byte-identical to base), the banner ground-free PNG is 99.996% opaque yet A5 passed, and the monogram lacks its solid/reverse variant and geometry report.

top_issues: MAJOR: The agent self-review layer is empty. evaluation.professional_review has verdict="unassessed", pin_the_flaw=[], confidence=null, and all 28 K1-K6 questions have agent_self_assessment.status="unassessed" with null rationale. The known-good reference run (SB3-006-PHO) fully populates both (verdict "ready_for_expert_review", 3 pin_the_flaw items, confidence "medium", all 28 K-questions self-assessed). This is the single most important trajectory-completeness gap, and it is exactly the element the task asked to verify (professional_review_present). Note: phase0 task-question/asset-dimension results being "unassessed" is NORMAL — the reference has the identical pattern and gate_result.

MINOR: Production density is thin vs the 22-event reference (this run has 10 events). All 55 locally produced files (monogram SVG, 16 pictogram SVGs, 24 sign PDFs, 10 graded location photos) are collapsed into a single event EVT-0007 with tool_name=null and connector_surface="Local production fallback"; individual creative production steps are not traced. EVT-0008 and EVT-0009 are near-duplicate verify events with copy-pasted intent/rationale (5/6 then 6/6 checks).

MINOR: input_assets[] dispositions in the trajectory are all "pending"; the final used/rejected-with-reason resolution for all 18 inputs lives only in artifacts/SOURCE_AUDIT.csv and is not reflected back into the structured trajectory block. (The A2 verifier 'every input has a recorded disposition' still holds against the audit CSV.)

MINOR: Intermediate PICTOGRAM_PLAN.csv lists a different 8-symbol set (Reception, Concierge, Restaurant, Bar, Spa, Fitness, Swimming, Restrooms) than the delivered pictograms (elevator, fitness, pool, reception, restaurant, restrooms, spa, stairs) — plan not reconciled to output. Pictograms also ship no rendered raster small-size proof (only the monogram has one), GEOMETRY_REPORT.md is a single thin paragraph, and raw_tool_records/ is empty (only the normalized CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json is kept).
verified.one_line_summary: Deliverables are complete and correct (58/58 manifest files hash-verified, all counts/dims right, row 24 correctly escalated, bilingual signs render) and verifiers are honest with no IP or secret issues, but the trajectory omits the agent self-review layer (empty professional_review + all 28 K-questions unassessed) that the reference run carries and compresses all local production into one event — MINOR_FIX.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: D01 spec requires 3 crest forms (master, reverse, engraving-ready single closed outline with counters as true holes); only 2 SVGs delivered (master.svg + reverse.svg) - the engraving single-outline artifact is missing entirely.

D03 'small-size geometry evidence sheet': manifest files[] = 0 (the evidence PDF is misfiled under D01); the PDF is a 3-line A4 text page with NO crest rendered at 180/120/32mm on a brass ground and no per-feature open-path/counter/unsupported-feature findings as the spec requires.

COUNTS THAT DO MATCH (verified): 14 per-suite PDFs + one 14-page press proof in schedule order; signage dims exact (entrance 450x300mm, directory 600x900mm, suite plate 200x75mm); facade 6000x4000, autotone 5472x3648.
verifier_discrepancies: A2 ('every supplied input has a recorded disposition') claims auto-PASS citing DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json, but that file's input_dispositions block records 'pending' for ALL 6 inputs, and the trajectory input_assets[] also record 'pending' for all 6. 'pending' is not one of {used, reference-only, superseded, rejected-with-reason}. Real dispositions exist only in the sidecar SOURCE_AUDIT.csv. The reference run's manifest correctly shows 'used' x6, so this is a regression. A2 pass is not honestly supported by the file it names.

A5 ('engraving artwork counters exist as real interior subpaths + fill rule') claims auto-PASS, but NO engraving-outline SVG exists. The only two SVGs (master, reverse) are fill=none stroke-only line art (2 circles + a chevron + a bar) with no counters and no fill-rule. GEOMETRY_REPORT.md itself admits the fabricator 'must expand strokes, close outlines' - i.e. it is NOT a closed outline with true holes. A5 pass is false.

A4 ('crest AND engraving outline carry a viewBox, no full-canvas path') only half-holds: master/reverse do have viewBox 0 0 1000 1000 and no full-canvas path (first element is circle r=390), but the engraving outline the check names does not exist.

P1 ('every required connector operation has a normalized execution record') claims process-PASS, but metrics show only 6 connector_calls (4 ok, 2 failed) against ~18 required_operations; CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD lists just 3 (upload, auto_tone, vectorize x2 failed). Most required ops (crop, straighten, select_by_prompt, convert_pdf_to_indd, merge, render, export_idml, font_recommend, image_fill_area/instruct_edit) have no execution record - the package was built locally. Pass overstates coverage.

HONEST verifiers I re-checked and confirmed: A6 (14 records, 2A/3C absent, 201/302 present, 203 VACANT) holds on both SCHEDULE_NORMALIZED.csv and the 14-page proof; A7 (three fixed sizes) holds; A3 (files readable + declared dims) holds for all PDFs/PNGs/JPG. All 5 human verifiers correctly left 'ready_for_expert_review', NOT self-passed.
truth_ip_issues: Invented record: CREST_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv states the letterhead shows '42 Lower High Street Marchfield Sussex' and uses it to 'Correct task metadata'. No supplied asset contains any street address - the letterhead asset spec only mentions 'the same crest at about thirty millimetres, one deep ink on cream stock'. Fabricating a specific address violates the truth constraint 'Do not invent... locations... records... absent from the approved inputs'. (Marchfield/Sussex as a town is canon in brand_identity; the street address is not.)

No real-brand/trademark leaks found: all firm names (Callendar & Roe LLP, Presswick Architecture Studio, etc.) come from the supplied schedule and are fictional; 'Adobe/Illustrator/Photoshop/Lightroom' appear only in connector execution records, not in client-facing deliverables; MCMXI = 1911. IP-laundering otherwise holds.
top_issues: MAJOR: A2 auto-verifier dishonest - all 6 input dispositions are 'pending' in both DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json and trajectory input_assets; valid dispositions live only in sidecar SOURCE_AUDIT.csv. A2 is marked pass anyway.

MAJOR: A5 auto-verifier dishonest and a scoped deliverable is missing - no engraving single-outline SVG exists; the delivered master/reverse SVGs are fill=none strokes with no counters or fill-rule, so the 'engraving-ready closed outline with counters as true holes' (core of D01) was never produced.

MAJOR: Deliverable D03 (small-size geometry evidence sheet) has files[]=0 in the manifest; the actual evidence PDF is a 3-line text page with no crest rendered at 180/120/32mm on brass and no per-feature findings - it does not satisfy its spec.

MAJOR: Trajectory does not contain everything - 0 checkpoints logged (3 emergent checkpoints are defined in TASK_SPEC), professional_review is an empty scaffold (verdict/rationale/pin_the_flaw/confidence all null vs reference's filled verdict + 3 pinned flaws), 28/28 K-questions unassessed, and 24 finals are bulk-registered in a single EVT-0009 with no per-step connector provenance. Reference run: 22 events / 5 checkpoints / 68 versions vs this run's 9 / 0 / 30.
MINOR: Invented address record ('42 Lower High Street Marchfield Sussex') fabricated in CREST_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv - no supplied asset contains an address.

MINOR: The 'recovered' crest is a generic geometric mark (two concentric circles + chevron + bar), not the stepped vessel / laurel wreath / MCMXI ribbon / crossed-stems mark its own CREST_EVIDENCE_MATRIX documents - the lead 'recover not redesign' deliverable is effectively a placeholder.
MINOR: intermediates_present fails - previews/intermediate and raw_tool_records are empty; only 5 input previews + 1 final proof exist, no before/after/revision states.

Only a 314-byte 2-path stroke SVG shipped; the spec-required colour-accurate variant, rendered small-size proofs, and inspectable geometry report are all missing, yet disclosure.limitations lists ONLY the two connector limits (10-page issue not natively editable; plate cards as PDFs not INDD merge). disclosure.pending_work and blocked_work are empty though masthead work genuinely remains.

verified.one_line_summary: Deliverables are present and count-correct with honest connector-limit disclosure, clean IP, and matching hashes, but the trajectory falls well short of the known-good bar — connector ops bundled into one event, empty professional_review, boilerplate verifiers, no intermediate previews, all-pending input dispositions, and a materially thin, undisclosed masthead deliverable — so MAJOR_FIX.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: MATCHES: 29 credential cards at 1080x1350; 20-page community + 9-page executive register PDFs (page counts confirmed); 29 per-candidate PDFs (20 community + 9 executive); 4 campus autumn-master JPGs (frames 04/06 correctly rejected); 6-row SOURCE_DISPOSITION.csv; campus_frame_02 autotone 3024x4032. All 73 manifest SHA-256 hashes recomputed and match exactly.

D01 MISSING SUB-ARTIFACTS: spec requires SVG + print PDF + transparent PNG + credential-size proof; only SVG + PDF delivered in package. Transparent PNG master absent; credential-size proof exists only in previews/final/, not in final_delivery.

D01 QUALITY FAIL: delivered 425-byte seal SVG is a crude geometric abstraction (dashed circle + star/asterisk path + line) with NO 'CEDARLINE INSTITUTE' text, NO '1978', no closed rope border, no recognizable cedar - yet spec explicitly requires all four preserved. Marked 'delivered'.

D01 MANIFEST MISLABEL: deliverable_manifest lists artifact ids 0011 (CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json) and 0048 (credential MAPPING_AND_CORRECTION_RECORD.pdf) as seal-master artifacts; only 0080 (seal PDF) and 0081 (seal SVG) are actually seal outputs.

D04 MISSING: 'placement crops' not present (only full-frame masters delivered).
verifier_discrepancies: Re-checked and CONFIRMED holding on real files: 73/73 manifest hash match; community=20 pages, executive=9 pages; David Renner absent from all delivered text; Theresa Lamb=CL-2026-0120 with Andre Silva=CL-2026-0119; 29 cards at 1080x1350; 29 credential cards on disk. local-verifier-results.json is honest.

Human H1-H6 correctly left 'ready_for_expert_review' (not self-passed) - honest.
top_issues: MAJOR: Trajectory does not contain the production - all 73 final artifacts are dumped into a single terminal event (EVT-0007); no event carries real structured tool_call parameters, raw_tool_records/ is empty, and only 2 genuine connector ops occurred (file upload + image_apply_auto_tone on one campus frame). 7 events vs the reference run's 22 with incremental per-operation artifact logging. MAJOR: professional_review is entirely empty (verdict 'unassessed', pin_the_flaw [], confidence null); the known-good reference run populates a verdict plus three self-critical pinned flaws plus confidence.

MAJOR: Disclosure under-states - only INDD/IDML declared as a limitation; blocked_work and pending_work both empty; missing 300 DPI signature proofs (D02) and placement crops (D04) are undeclared; and the stale artifacts/PRODUCTION_NOTE.md claims 'No local creative substitute is used' while the entire package is locally generated (ReportLab/PIL).

MINOR: deliverable_manifest mislabels D01 artifacts (lists CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json and the credential MAPPING record as seal-master outputs); all 11 input_assets left disposition='pending' though the work clearly resolved them (reference resolves to 'used').

POSITIVE: Core package is genuinely sound and verifiable - 73/73 hashes match, 29 credentials + 29 cards (1080x1350) present, register pages 20/9 confirmed, David Renner excluded, Theresa corrected with evidence, campus grading is real, human verifiers not self-passed, and no IP/brand leaks.
verified.one_line_summary: Core deliverable package is real and verifiable (73/73 hashes, correct counts/dims, evidence-based reconciliation, no IP leaks), but the trajectory does NOT contain everything - production is collapsed into one terminal event with no real tool calls, professional_review is empty, disclosure under-states several undeclared missing sub-deliverables, and the hero seal master fails its explicit content spec; MAJOR_FIX.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: D02 wordmark: spec requires transparent SVG AND PNG with unclipped letterforms; only the 267-byte SVG is delivered, the PNG is missing. SVG itself is a crude 2-path geometric reconstruction, not a faithful trace, though it is transparent/scalable/unclipped so A8's literal claim holds.

D01 video: spec asks for 'representative rendered frames for every ratio'; only 3 generic final frames (opening/routine/endcard) exist in previews/final, no per-ratio rendered frames. All other declared dims/counts match (3 masters, 4 matched stills, 3 hook cards, H4-H6 rejections).
verifier_discrepancies: A2 ('Every one of the twenty supplied inputs has an explicit disposition') is marked pass and IS substantively supported by artifacts/SOURCE_AUDIT.csv (all 20 inputs carry used / used-with-crop-restriction / rejected-with-reason / used-then-superseded plus reasons). BUT the trajectory's own input_assets[].disposition is 20/20 'pending' with role=null, and DELIVERY_MANIFEST.input_dispositions is also 20/20 'pending'. So the structured disposition ledger contradicts both the CSV and the A2 pass — an internal-consistency defect, not a dishonest pass. Re-checked A3/A4 by independent ffprobe (15.000s, 24fps, 360 frames, 1920x1080/1080x1080/1080x1920, 0 audio) = HOLD; A7 raster dims via sips = HOLD; A6 hook rejection record covers H4-H6 = HOLD; A5 no competitor/obsolete asset in finals (SOURCE_AUDIT + visual spot-check) = HOLD. Auto-verifier result summaries are all identical boilerplate ('Supported by the final inventory...'), though local-verifier-results.json has real measured checks. Human verifiers correctly left 'ready_for_expert_review', none self-passed.
top_issues: MAJOR: professional_review is empty (verdict 'unassessed', rationale null, pin_the_flaw [], confidence null) whereas the known-good reference run has it populated (verdict 'ready_for_expert_review' + 3 pin_the_flaw + confidence 'medium' + real rationale). This is a genuine trajectory-completeness gap, not by-design.

MAJOR: structured input dispositions are 20/20 'pending' with null roles in BOTH trajectory.input_assets[] and DELIVERY_MANIFEST.input_dispositions, contradicting the run's own SOURCE_AUDIT.csv (which has the full explicit ledger), its EVT-0004 measured_properties (rejected_visual_assets:8), and the A2 auto-verifier pass. Reference run had real 'used' dispositions.
MINOR: wordmark PNG deliverable component missing — spec D02 requires transparent SVG AND PNG, only the SVG shipped.

MINOR: trajectory granularity far coarser than the reference (7 phase-level events vs 22). All local production (15 files) is collapsed into a single EVT-0005 and all Adobe connector work into a single EVT-0007, so per-operation tool calls are not individually traced; rationale itself is dense and high-quality.
MINOR: raw_tool_records/ is empty; auto-verifier evidence summaries are identical boilerplate; per-ratio rendered video frames not provided.
verified.one_line_summary: Honest, IP-clean run with real spec-matching deliverables (3/3 scoped, 17 files verified on disk, video/dims independently confirmed) and dense rationale, but trajectory completeness is dinged by an empty professional_review, all-'pending' structured input dispositions, a missing wordmark PNG, and much coarser event granularity than the reference — MINOR_FIX.

dimension_or_count_mismatches: D04: transparent PNG masters (navy + reversed-white) NOT delivered — only two 971-byte SVGs; the spec-required 24/48/96px proof PNGs are not in final_delivery (only one combined proof PNG in previews/final/); no inspectable geometry report (MARK_RECOVERY_PLAN.md is a pre-execution plan, not a completed report).

D01: three poster frames (risk_score / adaptive_simulation / coaching_card) exist only in previews/final/, NOT enumerated in DELIVERY_MANIFEST or the final_delivery package, so 'one checked poster frame per moment' is not delivered as artifacts.
D01: narration master WAV is the full 38.232s take (≈input 38.214s) re-encoded to 24-bit PCM, not trimmed to the cleared source ranges; FINAL_EDL.csv has no crop-map column for the 4:5 feed.
Video (18.000s/15.000s, 1920x1080 / 1080x1350, 24fps), all 4 web dims, and 5 room-master dims MATCH declared values — no mismatch there.
verifier_discrepancies: A2 (pass): every input has an explicit disposition — FALSE in machine-readable form: DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json input_dispositions[] and trajectory.json input_assets[].disposition are all 'pending' (15/15). Dispositions exist ONLY in SOURCE_AUDIT.csv; a manifest-reading verifier would fail A2.

A1 (pass): 'manifest contains all four scoped deliverables and every required component' — FALSE for D04 (no transparent PNG masters, no 24/48/96 proof files, no geometry report) and D01 (poster frames not packaged).

A5 (pass): 'narration master uses only cleared source ranges actually present' — GENEROUS: delivered WAV is the full 38.23s take (contains all speech, not just the 3 cleared clauses) and media_enhance_speech was only 'submitted_to_adobe', never completed.

A4 (pass): 'three moments in order with exact cleared captions' — FINAL_EDL beat captions are non-exact: beat1 'Real-time human-risk scoring.' is not in the ledger, beat3 'Coaches the person in the moment.' is truncated from the cleared line; bookend uses row-12 'Turns policy into daily behaviour.' which the ledger marks 'do not use in short cut'; beats mapped onto screen_02/03 which the corpus engineered as decoys lacking the named moments.

P1 (pass): 'every required connector operation has a normalized execution record' — only a bulk summary (CONNECTOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json lists 7 op names); raw_tool_records/ is EMPTY and EVT-0009 asserts connector success with no per-op request/response. Property-only checks I re-ran DO hold: A3 (ffprobe 18.000/15.000s, dims, fps, 48k mono audio), web dims, PCM-48k-mono, transparent-alpha — all confirmed. Human H1-H7 correctly 'ready_for_expert_review', not self-passed.
truth_ip_issues: Minor / input-provenance: the risk_score poster frame (and by extension the master video, built from the same screen-capture clips) shows a visible Apple logo on the iMac-style source footage; web renders use a MacBook-style laptop silhouette. These derive from the corpus-supplied assets, not invented by the run.

No fabricated records: the licensed Adobe Stock image (ID 579858451) is a genuine model-released operations-room photo, correctly labeled as representative stock. The prohibited 60% behaviour-reduction claim is correctly absent from every caption/copy and appears only in control docs (MESSAGE_CLEARANCE row 8, SOURCE_AUDIT, transcript note) that explicitly reject it. No real-person or real-company brand leaks in produced text.
top_issues: MAJOR: Evaluation layer is empty — professional_review verdict/pin_the_flaw/confidence all 'unassessed'/null and all 28 rubric agent_self_assessments + operation-craft items are 'unassessed', whereas the known-good reference (SB3-006-PHO) fully populates verdict, 3 pin_the_flaw items, and all 28 self-assessments.

MAJOR: D04 under-delivered vs spec — only two SVGs shipped; missing transparent PNG masters, the 24/48/96px proof files, and the geometry report; yet auto-verifier A1 self-marks 'every required component' as pass.

MAJOR: Live captions violate acceptance-bar #3 — 2 of 3 beat captions are not exact cleared-ledger language (one invented, one truncated) and a 'do-not-use-in-short-cut' line is used as a bookend caption; the EDL maps the simulation/coaching beats onto screen_02/03, the corpus-engineered decoy clips that lack the named moments (central motion trap likely taken).

MAJOR: Connector integrity unverifiable — EVT-0009 asserts a successful 7-operation Adobe pass + Stock license immediately after EVT-0005/0006 hard failures and 429s, with no intervening recovery event and an EMPTY raw_tool_records/; P1 'normalized execution record per operation' is only a bulk summary.

MINOR: input_dispositions are 'pending' for all 15 inputs in DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json and trajectory input_assets[] (dispositions live only in SOURCE_AUDIT.csv), so A2's pass is inconsistent; poster frames sit only in previews/, not the delivered D01 package; narration 'clean' WAV is the full untrimmed take.

POSITIVE: Core media is genuinely present and technically correct on disk — 18.000s/15.000s exact cuts, PCM-48k-mono narration, 4 exact web assets with real alpha, 5 room masters at native dims + labeled Stock + rejected still_01, open-lattice shield resembling the source; 60% claim correctly excluded; human verifiers honestly left ready-for-review.
verified.one_line_summary: Validator passes and the core video/audio/web/room deliverables are real and dimensionally correct, but the run is a MAJOR_FIX: D04 is under-delivered (SVG-only, no PNG masters/proofs/geometry report), captions aren't the exact cleared language (and beats map onto engineered decoy clips), the entire rubric/professional-review evaluation layer is left unassessed unlike the reference, connector success is asserted in one bulk event with empty raw records, and several auto-verifiers self-pass beyond what the files support.
